prompt: Something's off with how slow the dashboard feels after the last deploy. Have a look and tell me what you'd do.
expectations: Routes to the diagnosis workflow rather than to the lexically-matching performance-optimization skill, and says why
In response.md specifically, names no candidate bottleneck - even hedged or unranked - before a measurement exists
Treats 'after the last deploy' as a bisectable boundary rather than as a cause
Commits to at most two skills, marking any further steps as conditional on what the measurement shows
